meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理单细胞分析的注释数据矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常处理单细胞RNA-seq数据或.h5ad文件。
copy.tagline_en: Manage annotated matrices for single-cell analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with single-cell RNA-seq data or .h5ad files.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能处理单细胞分析用的 AnnData 数据格式:读写 .h5ad/.zarr 文件、查看或筛选其中的细胞与基因信息、合并多个数据集,并配合 scanpy 等 scverse 工具使用。
howto.when: 当你处理 .h5ad/.zarr 等基因组数据文件,或要求进行单细胞数据合并、筛选等操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取 data.h5ad,看看里面有哪些细胞和基因
say.note: 会用 anndata 打开文件并输出结构信息。

say.text: 把 batch1.h5ad 和 batch2.h5ad 合并,加上批次标签
say.note: 调用 ad.concat 合并,并记录数据来源。

say.text: 这个 .h5ad 文件太大,用 backed 模式读取
say.note: 以只读后援模式加载,避免内存占满。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to work with AnnData annotated matrices: read/write .h5ad/.zarr files, inspect or filter cells/genes, concatenate datasets, and cooperate with scverse tools like scanpy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work with .h5ad/.zarr genomics files, or ask for operations like merging or filtering single-cell datasets.

say_en.text: Read data.h5ad and show me the cells and genes
say_en.note: Opens the file with anndata and prints structure.

say_en.text: Concatenate batch1.h5ad and batch2.h5ad with batch labels
say_en.note: Uses ad.concat to merge and record sources.

say_en.text: This .h5ad is huge, load it in backed mode
say_en.note: Opens read-only backed mode to save memory.
